points.left: The Spirit sends Barnabas and Saul to Cyprus. Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul. Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.
points.right: Inherited credentials are counted loss for knowing Christ. Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe. if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
